title: Give every wagon produce[] and consume[] entry its required fields

facts.note: Wagon definition files are found by path and file kind.
Fires when a wagon definition is written or changed.

values: produce[] or consume[] entry added or modified
facts.note: Needs a diff-level YAML observer that sees the produce/consume lists change.
Task text that mentions planning wagon artifacts.

fires: Planner adds a new produce[] entry to a wagon definition
Planner adds or edits a consume[] entry that declares an upstream artifact
Planner authors a new wagon with both produce and consume lists
doesNotFire: Editing wagon fields outside produce[]/consume[] (e.g. description only)
Editing contract or telemetry schema files themselves without touching wagon produce/consume entries
Code or test changes that do not touch wagon definitions

given: A wagon definition with produce[] and/or consume[] artifact lists
when: The planner adds or edits a produce[] or consume[] entry
then: Every produce[] entry declares name, contract and telemetry (optional: to, urn, version), and every consume[] entry declares name (optional: from, contract, telemetry, urn, version).
prefer: Write the contract and telemetry keys on every produce[] entry, even when their values are null as in the source's internal-artifact example (to: internal)
Give produce[].to only internal or external; omitting it means external
avoid: Leaving out contract or telemetry keys on a produce[] entry
A consume[] entry with no name
Fields other than the listed required/optional ones on produce[] or consume[] entries
A from value outside wagon:<slug>|system:<service>|appendix:<type>|internal, or a to value other than internal|external
why: Produce/consume entries are the declared artifact interface that contract, data-flow, semantic and telemetry-ownership checks resolve against, so their shape must be uniform.
evidence: Each produce[] entry has the name, contract and telemetry keys present, and only the optional keys to/urn/version beyond them; null contract/telemetry values, as in the source's internal artifact example (to: internal), are allowed
Each consume[] entry has the name key present and only the optional keys from/contract/telemetry/urn/version beyond it
to values are internal or external; from values, when present, match wagon:slug|system:service|appendix:type|internal
verifier_detail: Term produce_fields (produce[] entry fields): required = [name, contract, telemetry]; optional = [to (internal|external, default external), urn, version]
Term consume_fields (consume[] entry fields): required = [name]; optional = [from (wagon:slug|system:service|appendix:type|internal), contract, telemetry, urn, version]

Source example produce: {name: commons:ux:foundations, contract: contract:..., telemetry: telemetry:...}; {name: internal:cache, contract: null, telemetry: null, to: internal} — do not reject an internal artifact whose contract/telemetry keys are present with null values (an allowed example, not an exhaustive nullability rule)
Source example consume: {name: commons:ux:foundations, from: wagon:maintain-ux, contract: contract:...}
Missing produce[].to is treated as external
Required means the key is declared on the entry; the source states no further nullability constraint
